title: salvia fruticosa subsp. thomasii
intro: Salvia fruticosa subsp. thomasii, commonly known as Greek sage, is a subspecies of the Salvia fruticosa plant, which is a perennial shrub native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Salvia fruticosa subsp. thomasii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing and protect against infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve cognitive function due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Salvia fruticosa subsp. thomasii include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
